verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Gwen's Hallowed Mist or her Skip'n Slash window; you win if you soak Grit and force the all-in while her W is down.

brief.thesis: Sett has no ranged answer to Gwen's Q poke, but Gwen has no real answer to Sett once he closes the gap and W (Haymaker) is full of Grit. The matchup is decided by whether Gwen is allowed to kite behind Hallowed Mist or whether Sett forces the fight on his terms.

theirWindow.when: Right after Gwen's E dash lands
theirWindow.what: Skip 'n Slash gives her bonus attack speed, range, and magic damage on-hit for a few seconds, and hitting you again refunds part of its cooldown. Back off auto trades during this window instead of standing to brawl.

yourWindow.when: Her W is on cooldown and your Grit is high
yourWindow.what: With Hallowed Mist down she can't hide from a stun. Land E (Facebreaker) for the stun or slow, pop Q (Knuckle Down) for max-health damage on your next two hits, then expend W for the shield and true-damage punch.

start.why: The dominant start on record (81.3% pick, 46.2% WR over 13 games) — the AD, health, and lifesteal let you sustain through Gwen's Q poke while you look for trade windows.

boots.why: 75% pick, 41.7% WR over 12 games — magic resist cuts her Q and passive proc damage, and tenacity shortens her R (Needlework) slow.

core.why: Gives the move speed burst and on-hit damage needed to actually close the gap on a kiting Gwen, part of the 30%-pick core path.
Health and damage that scales your all-in once you're in melee range, second item in the same recorded path.
Tenacity and a damage-reduction shield so her Q/E on-hit chip doesn't delete you mid-engage.

situational.when: she builds tanky and you need the armor shred to keep killing her through sustain
the game goes long and you're winning extended ability-cooldown trades
you're split-pushing side lanes alone and she can't contest towers

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained AD and healing from prolonged melee trades is exactly what you need to out-sustain Gwen's ranged poke on the walk-in before your all-in lands.

summoners.why: The clear majority pick (86.7% pick, 46.2% WR) — Ignite punishes her passive healing on short all-in trades, and Flash guarantees your E/R engage actually connects.

playing.title: Soak hits before you punch
playing.detail: W (Haymaker) stores damage you take as Grit and expends it all on cast. Let a Snip Snip! or two land on you before you commit, then pop W for a bigger shield and the true-damage center hit.

playing.title: Don't walk into Hallowed Mist
playing.detail: Gwen's W only lets you target her if you step inside the mist. Bait it with minions or just wait out its 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown instead of forcing a trade on her terms.

playing.title: Punish the Skip'n Slash miss
playing.detail: If her E dash whiffs its follow-up hit, the cooldown isn't refunded and she's stuck in melee range with no escape for the full 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s. That's your window to all-in.

playing.title: Position for the E stun, not the slow
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if she's pulled in from both sides — keep lane minions behind her so the pull catches her between you and the wave, otherwise it's just a slow.

playing.title: Front-load Q into the all-in
playing.detail: Knuckle Down's bonus max-health damage on your next two attacks hits hardest as the opener, before her A Thousand Cuts passive starts healing her back.

playing.title: R requires entering the mist
playing.detail: If her W is up, The Show Stopper can't target her from outside Hallowed Mist. Either bait the mist down first or save R for after it's gone.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (sample sizes as small as 2-13 games for some branches) — the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own analysis layered on top.
